# pidginhost_bucket (Resource)

An S3-compatible object storage bucket. Creation and deletion are asynchronous; the provider waits for them to finish. Get access keys with `pidginhost_bucket_credentials`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pidginhost_bucket" "assets" {
  name        = "assets"
  quota_gb    = 50
  public_read = true
}

output "assets_url" {
  value = "${pidginhost_bucket.assets.endpoint}/${pidginhost_bucket.assets.full_name}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Bucket name, up to 63 characters. The API prefixes it to build `full_name`. Changing it replaces the bucket and **deletes its contents**.
- `quota_gb` (Number) Storage quota in GB. Changed in place with the API's `resize` action.

### Optional

- `public_read` (Boolean) Allow anonymous read access to objects. Changed in place with the API's `visibility` action. Defaults to `false`.
- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Creation time.
- `endpoint` (String) S3 endpoint URL.
- `full_name` (String) Full bucket name to use with S3 clients.
- `id` (String) Bucket ID.
- `object_count` (Number) Number of objects, at the last refresh.
- `region` (String) S3 region.
- `status` (String) Lifecycle status (`active`, ...).
- `used_bytes` (Number) Bytes stored, at the last refresh.

<a id="nestedblock--timeouts"></a>
### Nested Schema for `timeouts`

Optional:

- `create` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).
- `delete` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Setting a timeout for a Delete operation is only applicable if changes are saved into state before the destroy operation occurs.
- `read` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours). Read operations occur during any refresh or planning operation when refresh is enabled.
- `update` (String) A string that can be [parsed as a duration](https://pkg.go.dev/time#ParseDuration) consisting of numbers and unit suffixes, such as "30s" or "2h45m". Valid time units are "s" (seconds), "m" (minutes), "h" (hours).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import a bucket by its ID.
terraform import pidginhost_bucket.assets 123
```
